boundary: This is a timing ABI schedule: it assigns the hypercube route to tomotope-body ticks.  It is not a claim about calibrated optical pulse widths, detector jitter, or waveguide loss.
breakthrough: BT1406 turns the BT1405 continuous Q6 stress path into a complete 48-tick tomotope-body pulse schedule: 16 Q6 edge traversals times the q=3 pulse microcycle equals 48 body ticks.
